### 1. PROJECT OVERVIEW

**Aetherion Health** (v2.0.0) is an AI-powered healthcare platform built with React 18, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Redux Toolkit, and Framer Motion. It's a PWA with Firebase integration, socket.io, and Axios for API calls.

**Key Dependencies:** react-hook-form, zod (validation), @reduxjs/toolkit, redux-persist, recharts (charts), react-router-dom, framer-motion, react-hot-toast, lucide-react (icons), axios, socket.io-client, react-big-calendar.

**Project Structure:** 260+ TSX/TS files organized across: `src/components/` (14 sub-directories: admin, ai-assistent, appointment, common, dashboard, doctors, emergency, hospital, layout, oxygen, pharmacy, Section, slices, spline, ui, women), `src/pages/` (auth, Client with patients subfolder), `src/context/`, `src/store/`, `src/hooks/`, `src/services/`.

6. **Legacy AuthService** (`src/services/authService.ts`): Stores user in `localStorage.medicare_user`, provides `login/register/logout/getCurrentUser/isAuthenticated/hasRole`
7. **AuthContext** (`src/context/AuthContext.tsx`): React Context wrapper mapping roles to dashboard paths

**Roles defined across the system:**
- Main: `patient`, `doctor`, `hospital`, `pharmacy`, `admin`
- Extended (authSlice): `normal_user`, `client`, `hospital_admin`, `hospital_authority`, `pharmacy_admin`, `admin_applicant`, `blood_donor`, `emergency_volunteer`, `super_admin`

## Complete Aetherion Healthcare Platform Analysis

---

### 1. PROJECT OVERVIEW

**Aetherion Health** (v2.0.0) is an AI-powered healthcare platform built with React 18, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Redux Toolkit, and Framer Motion. It's a PWA with Firebase integration, socket.io, and Axios for API calls.

**Key Dependencies:** react-hook-form, zod (validation), @reduxjs/toolkit, redux-persist, recharts (charts), react-router-dom, framer-motion, react-hot-toast, lucide-react (icons), axios, socket.io-client, react-big-calendar.

**Project Structure:** 260+ TSX/TS files organized across: `src/components/` (14 sub-directories: admin, ai-assistent, appointment, common, dashboard, doctors, emergency, hospital, layout, oxygen, pharmacy, Section, slices, spline, ui, women), `src/pages/` (auth, Client with patients subfolder), `src/context/`, `src/store/`, `src/hooks/`, `src/services/`.

---

### 2. EVERY COMPONENT FILE - WHAT THEY DO

#### A. Core Infrastructure (5 files)

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `src/App.tsx` | Root app - wraps Redux Provider, PersistGate, BrowserRouter, Toaster |
| `src/main.tsx` | Entry point - renders App in StrictMode |
| `src/app/routes/AppRoutes.tsx` | Route definitions with AuthGuard, PublicGuard - checks `sessionStorage` tokens and role-based access |
| `src/app/routes/routeConfig.ts` | **112+ route entries** - all lazy-loaded. Covers public, auth, doctor, hospital, pharmacy, patient, admin routes |
| `src/config/routes.config.tsx` | AI Dashboard sidebar/feature route config with lazy-loaded component mapping |

#### B. Context Providers (2 files)

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `src/context/AuthContext.tsx` | React Context-based auth with login/register/logout/hasRole. Maps roles to dashboard routes (ROLE_DASHBOARD_MAP) |
| `src/context/ThemeContext.tsx` | Dark mode toggle with localStorage persistence |

#### C. Store / State Management (2 store indexes + auth slice)

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `src/store/store.ts` | **Simple store** - only auth reducer, auth blacklisted from persist |
| `src/store/index.ts` | **Full store** - 9 reducers: auth, client, doctor, hospital, appointment, emergency, pharmacy, admin, ui. Auth NOT persisted (whitelist excludes it) |
| `src/store/slices/authSlice.ts` | Full auth slice with **12 account roles** (`normal_user`, `client`, `doctor`, `hospital`, `hospital_admin`, `hospital_authority`, `pharmacy`, `pharmacy_admin`, `admin`, `admin_applicant`, `blood_donor`, `emergency_volunteer`). 5 profile upgrades (`client_patient`, `blood_donor`, `pharmacy_user`, `emergency_volunteer`). Multi-role support with `primaryRole`, `roles:[]`, `upgrades:[]`. Thunks: `loginUser`, `registerUser`, `logoutUser`. Reducers: login/logout/updateProfile/addRole/removeRole/setPrimaryRole/addUpgrade/removeUpgrade/switchRole/setOnlineStatus |

#### D. Services / API Layer (8 service files)

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `src/services/api.ts` | **Custom ApiClient** class - fetch-based with Bearer token auth (from `localStorage.medicare_user`), timeout, error handling (401 redirects to /login). Methods: get/post/put/patch/delete/upload. Also exports `apiService` with appointment/doctor/hospital/emergency/auth methods |
| `src/services/authService.ts` | Auth service with mock DB - login/register/logout/getCurrentUser/getProfile/updateProfile/changePassword/forgotPassword/resetPassword/verifyEmail/refreshToken. Stores user in `localStorage.medicare_user` |
| `src/services/adminService.ts` | Admin REST client - user management (CRUD/block/unblock/delete), doctor/hospital/pharmacy verification, analytics, reports, security logs, notifications, emergency dispatch |
| `src/services/hospitalService.ts` | Hospital service with **mock data** (3 hospitals, bed info per hospital) + filtering/sorting. Hospital CRUD, bed booking, ambulance management, ICU, oxygen, analytics |
| `src/services/pharmacyService.ts` | Pharmacy REST client - medicine CRUD, stock management, search, orders, prescriptions, delivery tracking, reminders, sales analytics |
| `src/services/oxygenService.ts` | Oxygen REST client - stock monitoring, center search, requests, emergency alerts, cylinder tracking, WebSocket subscriptions |
| `src/services/bloodDonationService.ts` | Blood donation REST client - donor registration, donation management, eligibility checks, donor search, blood stock, emergency alerts, donation camps, rewards |
| `src/services/womenCareService.ts` | Women care REST client - pregnancy tracking, appointments, medications, baby vaccines, child growth, menstrual cycle, gynecologist consultations, emergency support |

#### E. Layout Components (5 files)

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `src/components/layout/Navbar.tsx` | Full-featured navbar with: logo, nav links (Doctors, Hospital, Medicine, Women Care, Blood Donor, AI Assistant), search with categories (all/doctor/hospital/medicine), notifications dropdown, theme toggle, language selector, profile dropdown (profile/settings/security/help/feedback/logout), mobile menu. Role-based authenticated links for patient/doctor/hospital/pharmacy/admin |
| `src/components/layout/sidebar.tsx` | Collapsible sidebar with animated menu items, submenus (Women Care has 5 children), variants (glass/gradient/neon/solid), logout action, settings link |

- **Sidebar**: `variant?` (glass/gradient/neon/solid), `collapsed?`, `onToggle?`, `activePath?`, `onNavigate?`
- **DashboardLayout**: `children?`, `title?`, `breadcrumbs?` (Array<{label, path}>), `actions?`, `className?`
- **Input**: All react-hook-form register props + `icon`, `error`, `rightElement`, `leftIcon`
- **Button**: `variant` (primary/ghost/danger/outline), `size` (xs/sm/md/lg), standard button attributes
- **Avatar**: `name`, `size` (sm/md/lg), `src`
- **HealthHeatmap**: `geoData` (health data by division)

---

### 4. STATE MANAGEMENT

- **Redux Toolkit** with **9 slices** (`store/index.ts`): auth, client, doctor, hospital, appointment, emergency, pharmacy, admin, ui
- **redux-persist**: Auth is **excluded from persistence** (blacklisted in `store.ts`, whitelist excludes it in `index.ts`). All other slices are persisted.
- **React Context**: AuthContext (legacy), ThemeContext (dark mode)
- **Local state**: `useState` extensively in all components. Complex forms use `react-hook-form` + `zod`
- **Session storage**: `auth_token`, `user_role`, `user_name` stored via `sessionStorage`
- **Local storage**: `medicare_user` (auth service), `aetherion_users` (Login mock DB), `aetherion_session`, `theme`, `darkMode`

---

### 5. FORMS

| Form | Location | Fields | Submit Action |
|------|----------|--------|---------------|
| **Login** | `Login.tsx` | email, password, role (5 options), rememberMe | dispatches `login` to Redux, saves to sessionStorage, navigates to role dashboard |
| **Registration** | `Register.tsx` | fullName, email, phone, password, confirmPassword, gender, address, dateOfBirth, profileImage + role-specific fields | dispatches `login` to Redux, stores in sessionStorage, navigates to dashboard |
| **Register (alt)** | `Registration/RegistratinForm.tsx` | Same base + specialization/license/experience (doctor), hospitalName/bedCapacity (hospital), bloodGroup (donor) | dispatches `login`, navigates to `/dashboard` |
| **Forgot Password** | `ForgotPassword.tsx` | email (step 1), code + newPassword + confirmPassword (step 2) | Simulated API calls with toast feedback, navigates to /login |
| **Newsletter** | `Footer.tsx` | email | Animated submit with loading/success states |
| **Booking** | `appointment/BookingForm.tsx` | doctor, date, time, type, location, notes, symptoms | Calls `apiService.createAppointment()` |
| **Search** | `Navbar.tsx` | Search query with category tabs | Calls `searchService.globalSearch()` with geolocation |

---

### 6. API CALLS

**HTTP Client**: Custom `ApiClient` class in `src/services/api.ts` using native `fetch()` with:
- Base URL: `import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL` or `http://localhost:5000/api/v1`
- Timeout: 15s
- Bearer token from `localStorage.medicare_user`
- Automatic 401 redirect to /login
- Methods: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, UPLOAD (FormData)

**Auth Service** (`src/services/authService.ts`): Currently uses **mock data** (3 mock users) with `simulateDelay()`. All methods have TODO comments for replacing with real API calls.

**Api Service** (`src/services/api.ts` - apiService object): Has real API endpoints ready:
- Auth: `/auth/login`, `/auth/register`, `/auth/logout`, `/auth/profile`
- Appointments: `/appointments/user/:id`, `/appointments/doctor/:id`, CRUD + cancel/search/filter/statistics
- Doctors: `/doctors` (with filters), `/doctors/:id`, `/doctors/:id/available-slots`
- Hospitals: `/hospitals` (with filters), `/hospitals/:id`
- Emergency: `/emergency/services`, `/emergency/request`

**Admin Service**: Uses native fetch() with Bearer token. Endpoints under `/api/v1/admin/`.
**Hospital Service**: Currently uses mock data with filter/sort/pagination. Has `HospitalServiceAPI` class with real endpoints.
**Pharmacy Service**: Full REST client with endpoints under `/api/pharmacy/`.
**Oxygen Service**: REST client + WebSocket (`ws://localhost:5000/ws/oxygen/:id`) for real-time updates.
**Blood Donation Service**: Full REST client + SMS/Email notification endpoints.
**Women Care Service**: Full REST client under `/api/women-care/`.

---

### 7. AUTHENTICATION LOGIC

**Multi-layered auth system:**

1. **Login.tsx**: Custom `AuthService` class with mock DB (5 demo users: syeda@gmail.com/123456 for patient, pollob@gmail.com/123456 for doctor, etc.) - performs login, registration, password reset
2. **Redux authSlice**: Thunks `loginUser`, `registerUser`, `logoutUser` - currently use mock implementations
3. **sessionStorage**: Stores `auth_token`, `user_role`, `user_name` on login
4. **localStorage**: `aetherion_users` (all registered users), `aetherion_session` (for "remember me" - 30 day expiry)
5. **AppRoutes.tsx**: `AuthGuard` checks Redux `isAuthenticated` + `sessionStorage.auth_token` + role matching. `PublicGuard` redirects authenticated users to their role dashboard.
6. **Legacy AuthService** (`src/services/authService.ts`): Stores user in `localStorage.medicare_user`, provides `login/register/logout/getCurrentUser/isAuthenticated/hasRole`
7. **AuthContext** (`src/context/AuthContext.tsx`): React Context wrapper mapping roles to dashboard paths

**Roles defined across the system:**
- Main: `patient`, `doctor`, `hospital`, `pharmacy`, `admin`
- Extended (authSlice): `normal_user`, `client`, `hospital_admin`, `hospital_authority`, `pharmacy_admin`, `admin_applicant`, `blood_donor`, `emergency_volunteer`, `super_admin`

---

### 8. USER ROLES AND PERMISSIONS IN UI

**Public (no auth)**: Home, About, Services, Help, Feedback, Privacy, Blood Donors, Notifications, Search, QR Code, Doctors listing, Hospitals listing, Pharmacy, Emergency, AI Assistant, Women Care Dashboard, Oxygen Dashboard, Appointment views

**Patient** (`/patient/*`): Dashboard, Appointments, Messages, Medical Records, Billing, Orders, Discover, Emergency Request, Health Records, Health Timeline, Medical Reports, Physiotherapy, Prescriptions, Profile, Recommendations, Vaccine Tracking, Medicine Tracker, Mental Health, Nutrition, Sleep, Fitness

**Doctor** (`/doctor/*`): Dashboard, Profile, Schedule, Patient Management, Appointments, Prescriptions, Women Care, Reports, Emergency Cases, Messages, Analytics, Settings

**Hospital** (`/hospital/*`): Dashboard, Account, Admin Panel, Bed Management, ICU, Ambulance, Emergency Services

**Pharmacy** (`/pharmacy/*`): Dashboard, Account, Stock, Medicine Search, Orders

**Admin** (`/admin/*`): Dashboard, Live Monitor, User Management, Doctor Verification, Patient Management, Emergency Monitor, Security, Hospital/Pharmacy Management, Women Care Management, Messages, Complaints, Revenue, Reports, Analytics, AI System, Verification Center, Notifications, Audit Logs, Appointments, Meetings, Health Heatmap, Settings, Blood Bank

**Roles can be combined** via authSlice's `roles: AccountRole[]` and `primaryRole` system.

---

### 9. BUSINESS LOGIC IN COMPONENTS

| Component | Logic |
|-----------|-------|
| **Login.tsx** | `validateLogin()` - email regex + password min-length check. `validateRegister()` - fullName/email/password/phone/terms validation. `handleFemalePatientLogin()` - one-click demo login. `doLogin()` - mock auth + session + Redux dispatch + navigation |
| **Register.tsx** | Multi-step form validation (basic info -> role-specific fields). `handleNextStep()` triggers subset field validation. Profile upload as base64. Session storage on success |
| **ForgotPassword.tsx** | 3-step flow with countdown timer for code resend |
| **AuthService** (in Login.tsx) | In-memory mock user database, `getDefaultUsers()` always creates fresh demo users |
| **Footer.tsx** | Newsletter subscription with animated loading/success states |
| **Sidebar.tsx** | Collapsible navigation with submenu management |
| **useAppointment.ts** | Full CRUD with state management - categorizes into upcoming/past/today, provides search/filter/statistics/time slot availability |
| **useAuth.ts** | User loading on mount, token verification, role checking, error handling |
| **AuthContext.tsx** | `ROLE_DASHBOARD_MAP` - role-specific navigation routing |
| **womenCareService.ts** | Business logic: Naegele's rule for due date (`calculateDueDate`), gestational age calculation (`calculateCurrentWeek`), period/ovulation prediction |
| **hospitalService.ts** | Bed booking validation, availability checking, random bed/floor/ward generation |
| **AdminDashboard.tsx** | Fetches real dashboard data from API, fallback to mock data. Real-time greeting. Chart type selection for analytics |
| **bloodDonationService.ts** | Eligibility checking with 3-month deferral period calculation |
| **authSlice.ts** | Multi-role management: `addRole/removeRole/setPrimaryRole/switchRole/addUpgrade/removeUpgrade` |
